messages:
deploybot: Created tag v3.4.1-hotfix at release/3.4 (sha abc1234)

deploybot: Target environments: production (canary -> eu -> us)

deploybot: Canary window: 15m. Rollout plan: 10% -> 30% -> 100% unless rollback.

deploybot: Changelog summary:
- fix: batching OOM on long seqs (runtime guard)
- fix: preserve KV cache through warm restarts
- docs: quantization examples added for 4-bit profiles

morgan: thanks — any migration steps for Dedicated pools?

celeste: no schema changes. Recommend pinning critical routes on Dedicated for 24h: inference-fast, realtime-chat.

ben: ops note — create a short pin on dedicated pools and set traffic-split to 0.05 for canary.

ops-oncall: I'll watch metrics. Canary 15m ok but prefer immediate alert if error_rate > 2% or latency p95 increases > 40%.

morgan: If we need to rollback, command is:
```
# rollback to previous stable tag
deploybot rollback --tag v3.4.0 --env production
```

ben: Also add automatic rollback on spike: set rollback_threshold=2.0 (pct errors) and evaluation_window=10m.

deploybot: Acknowledged. Pin request: inference-fast -> v3.4.1-hotfix for 24h. Canary started for prod-eu at 2026-03-19T14:12:03Z :rocket:

ops-oncall: Watching dashboards (latency, errors, cpu/mem). Will post updates in 10m.

morgan: quick ping — release notes posted: https://internal.redwood/releases/v3.4.1-hotfix

celeste: cool. If canary looks good at 15m we proceed to us, then 100% after 1h. :thumbsup:

deploybot: Canary progressed to 30% (prod-eu + prod-us partial) at 2026-03-19T14:28:50Z. No automatic rollback triggered.

ops-oncall: All good so far; small p95 bump but within expected. Proceeding with staged rollout.

morgan: leaving the dedicated pin in place until tomorrow morning.

deploybot: Rollout complete: v3.4.1-hotfix at 100% production at 2026-03-19T15:35:10Z. Release tag immutable.
